purpose: Teach: 素晴らしく/長々/目の当たり/ひいては/がらみ/つれづれ/なにせ/もろもろ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、素晴らしく頑張ったな
lines.en: Riku, you actually did incredible work.
lines.style: Warm, genuine praise. Light at the start, lands solidly on 「頑張った」. No performance — just a friend saying what she sees. Direct eye contact energy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先生が長々と説明してたな、桜
lines.en: You sat through the teacher's whole long explanation, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, almost teasing acknowledgment. Slight smile in the voice. Light and unbothered — noticing her noticing him, deflecting the praise with gentle irony.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の活躍を目の当たりにして驚いたぞ
lines.en: Riku, I was genuinely surprised watching you in action.
lines.style: Sincere underneath the casual phrasing. Slight rise on the middle — letting the observation land. Not overdoing it, but letting him know she means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ひいては将来の夢につながる勉強しろよ、桜
lines.en: You should channel that into studying for your actual future, Sakura.
lines.style: Thoughtful, not lecturing. Quiet conviction. The gentle redirect of someone who cares — pointing her toward something that matters. Steady pace, no edge.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テストがらみで悩んでんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you're stressed about exams, aren't you.
lines.style: Perceptive and slightly teasing. Knowing tone — reading him accurately. Softens just before the period, like she's checking in underneath the wryness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、つれづれにマンガ読んでんな、桜
lines.en: You're reading manga in your spare time, aren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry observation, no judgment. Gentle call-out from someone he likes. Small smile underneath — acknowledging the distraction without making it shameful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、なにせ俺ら受験生だしな
lines.en: Riku, we're both exam students anyway, so what can you do.
lines.style: Reflective, accepting. Slight weary warmth — acknowledging shared reality without complaint. The tone of someone who's made peace with something difficult, temporarily.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、もろもろの参考書揃えたな、桜
lines.en: You really did gather all those reference books together, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet approval with underlying affection. Noticing her effort without announcing it. Gentle, close — the tone of someone seeing the work underneath the surface.
